result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but there is one clear content bug (a '−0%' discount badge) and a few minor truncation/layout concerns at the edges of horizontal carousels.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card in 'Popular right now' displays a '−0%' discount badge, which is meaningless and looks like a data/rendering bug (a zero-value promotion being shown).
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the discount value is 0, or fix the data source so the correct percentage is displayed.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' shows the restaurant name cut off as 'Trattoria Piccol' with no ellipsis, making the truncation look accidental rather than intentional carousel overflow.
issues.suggestion: Apply text-overflow: ellipsis to truncated titles, or ensure the visible name text is clipped together with the card at the viewport edge.

issues.description: A category filter chip at the far right of the chip row is cut off and appears as an almost empty pill, giving a broken appearance and no hint of its label.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip spacing/peek amount so a partially visible chip shows at least part of its label, or add a gradient fade to indicate horizontal scrolling.
